body.name: YuLearnerRegime
body.def: \(\mathsf Y_n\) denotes \(\|\widehat e_n-e\|_{L^2(P)}=o_P(n^{-1/4})\), \(\max_{a\in\{0,1\}}\|\widehat\mu_{a,n}-\mu_a\|_{L^2(P)}=o_P(n^{-1/4})\), \(\|\widehat\tau_n-\tau\|_{L^2(P)}=o_P(n^{-1/4})\), and \(\lvert\widehat{\bar\tau}_n-\bar\tau\rvert=O_P(n^{-1/2})\), the learner-rate part of Yu (2026), Assumption 4
